name: ATM Cassette 3
definition: Information on the cassette of an ATM.

PhysicalIdentification.name: Physical Identification
PhysicalIdentification.definition: Physical identification of the cassette for the ATM.

LogicalIdentification.name: Logical Identification
LogicalIdentification.definition: Logical identification of the cassette for the ATM.

SerialNumber.name: Serial Number
SerialNumber.definition: Serial number or unique identification of the cassette hardware.

SubType.name: Sub Type
SubType.definition: Type of items the cash-in takes.

MediaType.name: Media Type
MediaType.definition: Type of media inside the cassette.

MediaCounters.name: Media Counters
MediaCounters.definition: Counter per unit value or globally.

CassetteStatus.name: Cassette Status
CassetteStatus.definition: Status of the cassette. This element may not be provided if the status has not changed from the previous time the cassette information has been provided.
